data.review_body: Placed an order (first time user) and paid for it via PayPal. PayPal acknowledged order, provided a transaction ID and Invoice ID and the money was debited. No order was recorded in my AliExpress account, I left it a few days assuming that the system would catch up but it didn't. First tried to use the almost unusable chat to find out what had gone on and subsequently very slow email. In all cases day after day they just sent a screenshot of the find account button even though I had access to my account. After a week of this I raised a PayPal case and I await to see if my money is returned. I recommend avoiding this site despite the enticing prices, I have concluded based on the lack of customer support that the operation is a borderline scam.
data.review_headline: They will take and keep your money  and leave you with nothing

data.review_body:
AliExpress support is a joke! Lies, endless loops, and zero help!!
AliExpress support doesn't do its job at all! They just "feed you promises" to escalate your case, but nobody actually transfers anything. It is an endless loop of identical, robotic auto-responses that only work in one direction: "send us this, send us that".
My tablet is a confirmed counterfeit (verified by AIDA64). AliExpress even admitted it is fake! I have already uploaded all possible video and photo evidence.
Now they demand that I pay my own money to ship it back to China. First of all, I will not pay a single cent to return a scammer's counterfeit. Secondly, it is legally impossible: our local postal services have strict bans on shipping lithium batteries abroad. I already provided official refusal documents from several carriers!
I do not want your useless coupons. I demand my money back for this fake item. Stop this endless game and issue my refund! I absolutely refuse to accept any of your useless discount coupons—I demand a full monetary refund to my card immediately, strictly following your own I absolutely refuse to accept any of your useless discount coupons—I demand a full monetary refund to my card immediately, strictly following your own policy. #1120107362471902
UPD: Stop lying! Your email support is a total dead end and working as a one-way street. It does NOT accept any incoming replies from me! I cannot answer your emails because your system blocks it. Stop trying to hide from the public view. You already have all my videos, photos, and official carrier bans. Raise the full file and issue my monetary refund here, do not send me back to your broken email loop!
data.review_headline: AliExpress support is a joke! Lies, endless loops, and zero help
